markScheme.exemplarAnswer: A grade 9 response will: describe how governments are formed (election -> largest party -> PM -> Cabinet); argue it IS democratic (government comes from elected Parliament, PM is an elected MP, government can be defeated in Commons, elections are held at least every 5 years); argue it is NOT fully democratic (PM not directly elected, FPTP distorts results, coalition/minority governments may not reflect voters' preferences, PM can change without election); conclude: the system has democratic foundations but significant deficits - a directly elected PM (as in some countries) or proportional representation would make government formation more democratic.
